response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_telescopes AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM telescope_counts), shares AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, tc.telescope_count / (SELECT total FROM total_telescopes) as share FROM telescope_counts tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share)) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share)) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
